create_data_reader: create a DataReader instance to load OGB Mol-Hiv graph data from CSV files with configurable batch size
get_graph_by_idx: get a single molecular graph by index as a jraph GraphsTuple with bidirectional edges and label
iterate_data_reader: iterate over a DataReader to yield batched jraph GraphsTuple objects from the dataset split
enable_repeat_mode: enable repeat mode on a DataReader to cycle through the dataset indefinitely
use_dynamic_batching: configure a DataReader with dynamic batching for pmap-compatible fixed-size graph batches
